title: SplitConsentRecord
description: Recorded before a split can be booked (SPEC 11.2). All required fields must be true or present.

comparison_shown.description: Split and earliest all-together option shown side by side (step 1).

split_stated.description: Groups, flights, times, seats and arrival gap stated (step 2).

fare_treatment_stated.description: Clause 3.5 for covered, per-member amounts for not covered (step 3).

given_by.description: Adult in the party who said yes to this exact split.

teen_guardian_consent.description: Required true when a teen travels without an adult.

conditions_resolved.description: Any condition set by the customer is resolved and the final plan restated with a second yes (step 5).

lead_approval.description: Required when configured (OQ-06). Never replaces consent.
